Sam (CS): Drafting a "quickfire" 1-paragraph + 4-item checklist for AMs to run at kickoff. Keep it pasteable.
Ivy (Solutions): Love the name. One-liner prefill + minimal checks, please.
Sam (CS): Paragraph to paste to customer: "Weran a light, idempotent prefill to warm templates and recent history so your first replies are faster. We also reserve a small warm pool for the first 24 hours to reduce cold-start latency. Reply if you'd rather we don't."
Sam (CS): Checklist for AMs (copy into notes):
Sam (CS): - Prefill run? (idempotency_key used)
Sam (CS): - Warm pool: 2 sessions reserved for 24h
Sam (CS): - Client retry: 3 attempts with jitter + streaming fallback enabled
Sam (CS): - Capture 5 eval prompts and link to feedback survey
Noah (SRE): Ops bits: set autoscale min_replicas=2 for 24h then back to min=0. Health check: GET /healthz after pool creation. Record prefill_failures per-tenant.
Ivy (Solutions): One-line prefill (pasteable):
Ivy (Solutions): ```bash
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/prefill" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"tenant_id":"TRIAL-FAST","idempotency_key":"kickoff-$(date +%s)","items":[{"type":"template","name":"welcome"},{"type":"history","last_n":20}]}'
```
Claire (PM): Renewal-risk rule: day7 pulse -> if queries_day7 < 0.4 * avg(day1-3) OR p99_latency > 1.2s then schedule enablement outreach.
Noah (SRE): Alerts: 5xx_rate > 0.5% OR streaming_error_rate > 1% OR p99_stream_latency > 1200ms -> route to #oncall-infra and tag assigned AM.
Sam (CS): Demo note: ask ops-helper to mute deploy noise for short demos: `ops-helper mute deploys 30m tenant:TRIAL-FAST`
ops-helper: Done deploy alerts muted for 30 minutes for tenant:TRIAL-FAST :white_check_mark:
Ivy (Solutions): I'll add this quickfire snippet + curl to the CS templates and include the tiny customer blurb.
Sam (CS): Perfect. I'll add a line to the renewal playbook linking the day7 pulse. Thanks everyone. :sparkles:
